text:
Avery,
The launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026, but the security review now completes October 12 at the earliest and requires your completed approval for release. Nia owns the review; it may require remediation, and no new production date is authorized. Despite this, a staging demo can still occur October 8 using synthetic data, and you choose whether to accept it. I remain confident the team will adapt smoothly. Please advise whether to proceed with the staging demo or await final approval.
Best,
Jordan
